QuestInfo.name: Cygnus's Last Request
QuestInfo.0: Cygnus is now truly Ereve's Empress. She wants to ask you for one more favor. Talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: This is her request. Take part in the battle and save Ereve.\r\n#b(Talk to Kiriru to ride the Airship and go to the Battleground.)#k
QuestInfo.2: The Black Wings have come! Head to the Battleground and save Ereve.

0.0: #h0#, I know you've done so much already to help us. But could I ask one more favor of you?

yes.0: Though I've accepted Shinsoo's power, Ereve's army is not ready to take on the Black Wing invaders. Could you please join the battlefield to protect Ereve?
yes.1: Thank you. May Shinsoo's blessing be with you...\r\n#b(Talk to Kiriru to ride the Airship to the Battleground.)#k

default.0: Please save Ereve.\r\n#b(Talk to Kiriru to ride the Airship to the Battleground.)#k
